verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Following the color-coded legend from p.4 across p.11-16: LA cable (orange) and AC earthing cable (green) run from the roof LA marker down the parapet and exterior wall through vegetation to ground-level AC Earth Pit and DC Earth Pit markers (p.17-18); a red line marks DC cable exiting through a 1-inch conduit into the equipment room (p.14), connecting to the INVERTER/ACDB/DCDB/Battery/UPS diagram (p.15-16). However, the run terminates at the Meter Box (p.9), which shows only a bare, unconnected wire stub with no installed main panel/cubicle to terminate into.
verdicts.rationale: The DC/AC/earthing/LA cable path is traceable and continuous through the equipment room and earth pits, but the final termination at the main meter panel is an unfinished/orphan end -- explained by the building being under construction and the main meter not yet installed, rather than a design or documentation defect.
